Compatible for Hyundai Palisade 12.3-inch Dual Displays &A/C Display
for 2026 Palisade (SE/SEL Convenience/SEL Premium/Limited/XRT Pro/Calligraphy)

Why Choose Coleya's 2026 Palisade 12.3Inch&A/C Screen Protector?
1.Coleya is a professional screen protector company, with high-quality raw materials, the latest technology applications, data collected from various aspects, and presenting high-quality products
2.Coleya 2026 Palisade protective film is made of high quality materials, only 0.125MM thickness, after use is still the touch of the original screen, moderate 4H hardness, so that it is the maximum balance between protection and sensitivity
3.Coleya service, considering the needs of customers and starting from the actual situation of customers, can provide customers with return and exchange services, so that your shopping has no worries!

Installation Steps:
1. Compare the protector to your display
2. Clean the screen: Clean the screen with the wet and dry cloths provided in the kit
3. Use dust removal stickers to remove surface dust and ensure the screen is completely clean
4. Use the positioning labels to align the protector on the screen. Make sure the protector is in the correct position
5. Tear off the back of the YELLOW label protective film clockwise, Use the card in one direction to remove the bubbles; Tear off the GREEN label protective film
6. Clean the screen with a microfiber cloth, then the installation is complete

Package Included:
4 x High-Quality Screen Protector
4 x Installation Auxiliary Tools
(Cleaning cloth, Dust removal sticker, Positioning label)
1 x Installation&After-Sales Manual

items: 【12.3Inch&A/C Screen Protector】For 2026 Palisade (SE/SEL Convenience/SEL Premium/Limited/XRT Pro/Calligraphy), for Hyundai Palisade Dual 12.3In&A/C Displays, 2026 Palisade Accessories

【100% Match】It fits the 2026 Palisade Display perfectly, just like the original equipment. It's the same size as 2026 Palisade SEL Convenience, it won't damage the screen and is easy to install and remove

【HD&Sensitivity】Coleya 2026 Palisade Limited screen protector of 0.125mm thick, made of thermal nanotechnology, more sensitive to touch. 99.99% optical grade high light transmittance, enhances screen visibility, and can effectively prevent glare

【Reduce Fingerprints】This 2026 Palisade XRT Pro screen protector, its hydrophobic and oleophobic coating can effectively reduce fingerprints from sweat. Precise laser cutting, rounded edges, delicate polishing, making it smoother to the touch

【Easiest Installation】It is very simple to install 2026 Palisade screen protector according to the instructions, don't worry about air bubbles, enjoy your Palisade 12.3Inch&AC screen like it doesn't exist. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us, we will be happy to help you!
